enriched_activities.desc: Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn again. Pull blanket down. Move arm. Adjust position. Continue sleeping.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face, brushing teeth, getting ready for the day
enriched_activities.desc: Open eyes. Sit up in bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wash face. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out eggs and milk. Close refrigerator. Crack eggs into bowl. Turn on stove. Pour eggs into pan. Cook eggs. Eat breakfast. Drink milk. Wash dishes. Put dishes away.

enriched_activities.activity: Changing into work clothes and packing work bag
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Take out shirt and pants. Take off sleepwear. Put on shirt. Put on pants. Put on socks and shoes. Pick up work bag. Place laptop in bag. Place stethoscope in bag. Zip bag. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for the work shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap transit card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Listen to music. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Push door open. Walk to locker room. Change into scrubs. Walk to ward.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional, attending to patients and clinical duties
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at ward. Put on gloves. Check patient vitals. Administer medication. Update patient records. Consult with doctor. Assist in procedure. Walk to next patient. Talk to patient. Adjust IV drip. Clean equipment. Take lunch break. Eat lunch in cafeteria. Return to ward. Attend team meeting. Review lab results. Prepare discharge papers. End shift.

Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Tap card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Listen to music. Arrive at stop. Stand up. Walk to exit. Get off bus. Walk home. Unlock door. Enter home. Close door. Take off shoes. Hang up coat.

Walk to kitchen. Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables and meat. Close refrigerator. Wash vegetables. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Place pan on stove. Add oil. Add meat. Stir meat. Add vegetables. Stir fry. Add sauce. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water. Wash dishes. Put dishes away.

Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Adjust volume. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Eat snack. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bedroom.
Walk to bathroom. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Turn on water. Apply soap. Rinse body. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off water. Dry body. Put on clothes. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Using the computer for personal browsing and winding down
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Open laptop. Press power button. Wait for login. Enter password. Open browser. Type website. Scroll through page. Click link. Read article. Watch video. Adjust volume. Close browser. Shut down computer. Stand up. Walk to living room.

enriched_activities.activity: Watching TV and relaxing before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Sit on sofa. Change channel. Watch TV. Pick up phone. Check social media. Put down phone. Adjust volume. Get up. Walk to kitchen. Get water. Return to sofa. Drink water. Watch TV. Turn off TV. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening hygiene routine and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Wet toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Wash face. Dry face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

Lie in bed. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Pull blanket up. Turn to right side. Adjust pillow. Stretch legs. Remain still. Breathe deeply. Turn again. Pull blanket down. Move arm. Adjust position. Continue sleeping.
